title: ctenopteris excaudata
intro: Ctenopteris excaudata, commonly known as New Zealand fern or Kahakaha, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol and blood pressure, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ctenopteris excaudata include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable resource in the field of phytotherapy. The bioactive constituents of Ctenopteris excaudata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
